headline: SEA @ KCR matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 5.29 at KCR 2.88, with a projected total of 8.18. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward SEA: SEA moved +0.80 runs while KCR moved -0.93, changing the projected margin by +1.73 runs. NRFI probability rose +11.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Bryan Woo has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 3.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Bobby Witt Jr., Maikel Garcia, Julio Rodríguez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Rob Refsnyder, Connor Joe because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
